rdfs:label: contentMap
rdfs:comment: Language-tagged variants of an ActivityStreams Object's `content` — keys are BCP 47 language tags, values are the localised content (often HTML).
notes: The fediverse's standard mechanism for multi-language posts. Mastodon, Misskey, and most ActivityPub servers populate this when an author tags a post's language. Clients select on locale; server-side translation features (Mastodon "translate") add machine-translated entries here.
